lessons.lesson: Real deployed projects carry production secrets — intake MUST audit before any code touch
lessons.action: Security/Deploy Gate must check for .env, SSH keys, tokens, server IPs BEFORE creating working copy

lessons.lesson: Finding security issues does NOT prove Factory is smarter than vanilla Codex
lessons.action: Never claim Factory superiority from issue discovery alone — requires controlled comparison

lessons.lesson: Complexity classification (multi-role, 15 models, 75+ URLs) should trigger Diagnostic Gate
lessons.action: Auto-suggest Diagnostic Gate for projects above complexity threshold

lessons.lesson: Working-copy isolation works: original project remained untouched through all phases
lessons.action: Working-copy creation is mandatory for all realworld phases

lessons.lesson: Local validation (manage.py check, smoke test) catches basic issues before any changes
lessons.action: Baseline validation should be step 1 after working-copy creation

lessons.lesson: Django 6.x compatibility issues are environment problems, not app bugs
lessons.action: Test repair policy: CLASSIFY before FIX

lessons.lesson: 9 files changed for security, 0 app code changes — security hardening is surgical
lessons.action: Security hardening must NOT touch app logic; config/docs only

lessons.lesson: Secret rotation boundary: Codex can DOCUMENT what to rotate but CANNOT rotate for user
lessons.action: User secret rotation is always user's responsibility; never automated by Factory

lessons.lesson: Security/Deploy Gate checks (10/10) provide structured confidence in hardening
lessons.action: Formalize Security/Deploy Gate with specific checklist items

lessons.lesson: Tests improved 13→21 (+54%) without touching app code — targeted repair works
lessons.action: Test repair must be CLASSIFICATION_FIRST: environment vs code vs data

lessons.lesson: 2 skipped tests (Django 6.x ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH) are honest skips, not failures
lessons.action: HONEST_SKIP_ALLOWED policy: document reason, do not fake-pass

lessons.lesson: Never claim 21/2/0 as 23/23 full pass — skipped is not passed
lessons.action: Verifier must check for skip-hiding (count skip != 0 when tests < total)

lessons.lesson: Final delivery must include user-facing security checklist (rotation items, not secrets)
lessons.action: Security/Deploy Gate must produce user rotation checklist in final output

lessons.lesson: Production deployment readiness is a SEPARATE claim from local validation success
lessons.action: Never conflate 'working copy safe for local dev' with 'production ready'

lessons.lesson: v0.5 remains blocked — REALWORLD-2 success does not unblock it
lessons.action: Each phase must re-confirm v0.5 BLOCKED status

new_rules_needed: Security/Deploy Gate: mandatory for any project with deployed traces
Test repair policy: CLASSIFICATION_FIRST, HONEST_SKIP_ALLOWED, no fake pass
User secret rotation boundary: document-only, never automated
Production readiness gate: separate from local validation gate
existing_rules_strengthened: Context Packet required for realworld phases
Diagnostic Gate auto-suggest for complex projects
Phase close context update for long-horizon continuity
